notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This release fixes a couple small issues that we were notified about.

[h3]Changelog[/h3]

[list]

notes.title: Puzzle Compound Release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re happy to finally release our game, Puzzle Compound! To celebrate the release, we have a launch discount of 10%!

Here’s all of the maps that you can play!

[h1]Jefferson’s Mansion[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/7bd1176cd8847c28a87e1269453a019603b1e7ff.png[/img]
The Jefferson's are on holiday and you've decided to check out what their house has to offer. Can you work together to explore the mansion and uncover it's secrets?

[h1]The Forgotten Castle[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/95cf0a72b2bd9183239b544f6d42b765d89bf60a.png[/img]
Your adventuring party has been transported to The Forgotten Castle. Many adventurers have been sent here but none have returned. Can you solve it's mysteries and make it out alive?

[h1]Bank Heist[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/b2edc0cbb46c508243a1135b3f394bf8c0d05a3b.png[/img]
Your party of "security professionals" have arrived at your next score. Can you bypass the banks security systems to retrieve your retirement money?

[h1]Wild Wild West[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/43332806da4fbc2949aa35a2bbb648d2ce466998.png[/img]
Your band of outlaws are hunting for gold and got split up. Can you reunite with your team, get into the mine to retrieve the treasure, and bring it back to the train?

[h1]Escape to Athelay[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/4474ccd73bfbfab363dc87afbb9ad077c71cb2e5.png[/img]
Your party has "borrowed" some prototype combat gear and are now on the run. Can you make it to the extraction point and escape the city before you're caught?

We’ve also added achievements for people to collect. If you have any issues, please reach out and let us know. Thanks to everyone who has provided feedback during the demo to make the game what it is today, and thanks to everyone who purchases the game. We hope everyone enjoys it!

notes.title: April Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After reviewing the Next Fest Feedback, we wanted to release an update to the demo and make a few announcements.

[h1]Pricing[/h1]
We are happy to announce that we have completed development of all of the maps and are doing final testing and polish. With this, we want to announce that the [b]game is releasing May 25th for a price of $12.[/b]

We will be releasing the final trailer for the game which will show off all of the maps on May 15th, and at that time the free demo will no longer be available for new players. If you would like to play the free demo, we’d suggest playing it soon!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[previewyoutube=gevbYPXi4KA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Inventory[/h2]
One of the biggest pieces of feedback we received was being able to hold multiple items. So we have added an inventory system to the game. You can now hold up to 5 items at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/b854837ba1cd0447b2fdab148f3c60223214377b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Interact Glow Updates[/h2]
Another piece of feedback we received involved the interact glow effect we use to help players find items they can interact with. The flashing was harsh on some players so we’ve updated it to be softer. Now the glow’s strength is determined by the distance from the player. The closer the player is to the item the softer the glow effect is, and the farther away the player is the stronger the effect is. We’ve also changed the color to be white so that it’s easier to look at when close up. 

[h2]Third Person Mode[/h2]
Unfortunately, it was reported that players had issues with getting motion sickness from playing. In order to help prevent motion sickness for players, we have implemented a button to switch from first to various third person mode cameras.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/2e2186b1937740babc2b4d5851322ffc843aa183.jpg[/img]

[h2]Switch Places / Trapped Notification[/h2]
In order to make sure that people didn’t think that they were soft locked in certain parts of the game, we have added a popup notification when a player gets trapped in a location and everyone needs to work together to get them out. If needed there is also now a button combination that will allow the players to switch locations.

[h2]New Controls[/h2]
We’ve updated the controls to be simpler while adding in new actions for players. The biggest change is interacting, picking up, and dropping items are all one button now. We’ve also added the following new actions players can use.

- Camera Zoom - To make it easier to see items from distance and to read text you can now zoom the camera in.
- Hold to crouch, sprint - Some players enough holding to sprint and crouch so we’ve added that as an option.
- Rotating Items - You can now rotate items to better align with the direction you want them in.

[h2]Miscellaneous Changes[/h2]
- Tab Map Update
- Map Notification Pings
- Tutorial Map / Lobby Tips
- Steam Names Pulled
- Map Updates and Bug Fixes

Thanks again everyone for the feedback and suggestions. We’re hard at work adding the final touches to the game in preparation for the final release!

notes.title: Dinner Menu Patch
notes.content:
Following our recent update, we received some reports of an issue affecting a few groups playing the demo not being able to solve the dinner menu puzzle. After investigating, we were able to identify and resolve the issue, and we think this is likely related to an issue that was affecting some groups with the card game puzzle that we had previously been unable to replicate.

We're sorry for the inconvenience this may have caused some players, but we definitely appreciate everyone who reached out letting us know of the problem.

Thanks for playing, and we hope everyone enjoys the demo and looks forward to the release in May!

notes.title: February Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! First of all, we would like to thank everyone for the immense amount of feedback that you all have been sending in. We’ve been reviewing the comments and wanted to release a small update to the demo to hopefully address at least some of the common concerns.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Motion Sickness & Brightness Updates[/h2]

Two common complaints we received were regarding people having motion sickness and issues with the brightness of the game. 

We made a few adjustments to help with this:

[list]
[*] The default FOV is now 95 instead of 90. If needed, you should be able to further tweak the FOV in the graphics settings (Graphics → FOV).
[*] Flashing effects for objects has been toned down to not be as bright and as fast. We will be looking into changing the effect for interactable objects in the future to get rid of the flashing effect entirely.
[*] We have added options to change your walk and run speeds in case the default walk speed is too slow or fast (Controls → Walk/Run Speed)
[*] We tweaked the cel shading so that the map should no longer appear as bright as before. If it is still too bright, you can edit the gamma settings (Graphics → Gamma).
[/list]

[h2]Puzzle Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Dinner puzzle should not double count items if they are picked up and placed again.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cards could fall through the desk.
[*] The guiding circle hint card is now no longer hidden.
[*] Fixed softlocking with multiple people getting locked into the bathroom.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Exit to Desktop went back to the Main Menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where items could become large when picking up and dropping too quickly.
[*] Updated some in game images that were blurry from a distance.
[*] Fixed an issue where non-host players could see “Open/Close Door” text for locked doors.
[/list]

In the coming months we will be focusing on the getting the game ready for release (May 25th), but we will continue to monitor for feedback and suggestions, so definitely keep writing in! If there are pressing issues, we will update the demo, but we will continue to take the feedback and make changes for the final release of the game.

Thanks again everyone for the positive feedback and suggestions. We’re happy to know so many people are enjoying the demo and are looking forward to the main release.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Update
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest Update

Hello everyone! To prepare for the Steam Next Fest, we have updated the demo.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]End Game Poses[/h2]

When the first player enters the end game room, everyone will be sent to a new end game pose screen where everyone can pick a pose so that everyone can take screenshots to show off that they beat the map. We hope you all have fun with this feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/e99bcc5576bb043ce4133d5b79ab4483cf3882b4.png[/img]
[h2]Full Controller Support[/h2]

There is now an in game keyboard for entering in player names and game codes to make the process easier for people who are using a controller. Starting at the main menu, you should be able to fully navigate the menus, host/join a game, and play with only using a controller. If you run into any problems with using a controller, please let us know.

[h2]Roadmap to Release - May 25th, 2023![/h2]

We’re proud to announce that we’re targeting May 25th, 2023 as the release date for Puzzle Compound! We’re working on finishing the final map as we speak with internal playtests beginning soon. Along with that, we’re also working on additional features and polish, such as Steam player name and achievement support.

In the coming months, we’ll be releasing short previews of the other maps here and on our YouTube channel. Be sure to check back to view those updates!

We hope you are looking forward to the release of the full game!

notes.title: Visual Update
notes.content:
[h1]Cel-shading[/h1]
We recently updated the visual style of Puzzle Compound. Instead of a darker gloomier look we wanted something brighter, so we switched the game to have a cel-shaded look. This helps brighten up the game and allows for some of the colors to really pop when seeing them. This also makes the game feel more like a relaxing experience that can be enjoyed with friends, which was the original idea we had. Here’s a clip of what the new style looks like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/c48de71160b05e2ccd564d8e0b244e08395fdc62.gif[/img]

[h1]Social Media[/h1]
In an effort to try to gain at least 1000 wishlists by the time we release, we hope to start releasing more content on our YouTube channel and Twitter account to show off puzzles, new features, and how we developed parts of the game. If you’re interested in getting a sneak peak of some of the things we’re working on, we recommend you give our YouTube channel or Twitter account a follow!

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6VIBlXXvw56l-mXP3V3DQA

Twitter: https://twitter.com/Noble_Phantom
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks for reading. We hope you all enjoy the demo and look forward to the full game when it’s released.

notes.title: May 2nd Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we have released an update to Puzzle Compound introducing some new features as well re-enabling voice chat with a new system.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]UI Updates[/h2]

We have updated the way we display interacting and dropping objects. Now when you look at an object it will popup interact text around it to inform you what interacting with it does and what button to press to interact with it. Dropping item text is now displayed in the bottom left corner or next to item, which ever is more convenient. Note text now appears at the bottom of the screen and will resize to fill the content as needed. Notifications will appear in the top right, whenever they are displayed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/54d6f719e6eff27f92bc2818a14df66ec8d018c9.gif[/img]

[h2]Ping System[/h2]

Whenever you have something important you want to remember like a puzzle’s location you can now use our ping system. Pressing the ping button with place a marker on the map at that location. When looking away the marker will stay on the screen so that you can always find it. Looking at the marker again and pressing the ping button will dismiss it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/a596906713428514a13ee95be78cd8e45ae2da44.gif[/img]

[h2]Ready Up & Character Selection[/h2]

We’ve updated how you share codes in game and start the game as well as now allow each player to change their skin rather than have one randomly assigned. In the map there is a display that describes the scenario and has buttons to view/copy the code. Each player also has a display associated with them where they can change the skin of their character as well as ready up. Once all players are readied up, the game will start after a short countdown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/a3838bd434c5f8518fd2a7e83815c4c440efa2dd.gif[/img]

[h2]Other Features[/h2]

- You can now press a button to see your character in third person
- We’ve made some efficiency updates to hopefully have the game run better
- Voice chat is re-enabled using a new voice chat system

[h2]Social Media[/h2]

In an effort to try to gain at least 1000 wishlists by the time we release, we hope to start releasing more content on our YouTube channel and Twitter account to show off puzzles, new features, and how we developed parts of the game. If you’re interested in getting a sneak peak of some of the things we’re working on, we recommend you give our YouTube channel or Twitter account a follow!

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6VIBlXXvw56l-mXP3V3DQA
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Noble_Phantom

---

Thanks for reading. We hope you all enjoy the demo and look forward to the full game when it’s released.

notes.title: Quarterly Update Spring 2022
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Welcome to the first of our quarterly updates for Puzzle Compound. Currently we are aiming to release the full game with five maps sometime Spring 2023. Between working on the new maps, our goal is to add various quality of life and polish updates which will be added to the demo once every quarter, starting with today!

Let’s get on to what changes we’ve made as of this update.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Map Update[/h2]

We have redesigned the look of the mansion map. While the puzzles and overall layout remain the same, the walls and floors have better coloring and textures and there is actual lighting throughout the map. This was done in order to closer match the quality of the other maps we’ve been working on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/5d0909d971c638e14ff32e4afdc7f45b9186c8ea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/595fec0a5be202ce4823af4bd0d641707c031540.png[/img]

[h2]Hint System[/h2]

The hint system has been completely overhauled. Now hints will be available to you regardless of your proximity to the puzzle, and each puzzle has a series of hints which get more and more specific. There’s also a reminder about hints if you haven’t solved a puzzle in 8 minutes. If players find a particular puzzle too confusing or challenging, continuing to press the hint button after all hints have been displayed will automatically solve the next puzzle. Hints can also be accessed by the pause menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/ef3bc89b94acfe9a6114becc7f9e1f213f874f7d.png[/img]

[h2]Item Snapping[/h2]

Some items need to be placed in specific locations to solve puzzles, and to make the process easier, we have created a system where items will be snapped to their particular location if you are pointing near where the items need to be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/56d9f1534927827d58fd7f7f31a9e28c008c18b7.gif[/img]

[h2]Other Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Objects that you can interact with now have a slight glow to make sure they are visible in low light environments.
[*] We have added a feedback form to the game which is accessed after completing the demo map or by the main menu. Any feedback, either positive or negative, will be very helpful in making the game as good as it can be!
[*] Additional character models were added for players on the mansion experience map.
[*] Additional sound effects have been added to the game.
[/list]

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]

[h2]Next Update[/h2]

Our goal is to release another update to Puzzle Compound in the Summer with some additional quality of life and polish updates, including a ping system that will allow players to point out something in game that they want another player to pay attention to.

[h2]New Maps[/h2]

As of this post, we have fully completed our second map in the game, the Castle Experience, and are finishing up polishing the third map, the Heist Experience, following some playtests with friends. While these won’t be available in the demo and will only be a part of the full game when it is released, we hope you look forward to seeing more of them when we start to show more of them off in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/a32c47a3132cd30e8cd7be99290be8b8174e7d16.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40698777/acab11c5b9ec147182d5c68a268fd5586b515bea.jpg[/img]

[h2]Social Media[/h2]

In an effort to try to gain at least 1000 wishlists by the time we release, we hope to start releasing more content on our YouTube channel and Twitter account to show off puzzles, new features, and how we developed parts of the game. If you’re interested in getting a sneak peak of some of the things we’re working on, we recommend you give our YouTube channel or Twitter account a follow!

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6VIBlXXvw56l-mXP3V3DQA
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Noble_Phantom

----

Thank you for reading our first Quarterly Update post. We hope you all enjoy the demo and look forward to the full game when it’s released.
